001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.controller;
002
003import android.os.Bundle;
004import android.util.Log;
005import android.view.Menu;
006import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
007import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
008import androidx.appcompat.widget.PopupMenu;
009import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;
010import android.view.LayoutInflater;
011import android.view.View;
012import android.view.ViewGroup;
013import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner;
014import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelProvider;
015import androidx.navigation.Navigation;
016import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.MapsPinsNavGraphDirections;
017import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
018import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.adapter.PinsAdapter;
019import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.databinding.FragmentPinsBinding;
020import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
021import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.PinViewModel;
022import java.util.List;
023
024public class PinsFragment extends Fragment {
025
026  private FragmentPinsBinding binding;
027  private PinViewModel pinViewModel;
028  private static final String TAG = PinsFragment.class.getSimpleName();
029
030  @Override
031  public View onCreateView(LayoutInflater inflater, ViewGroup container,
032      Bundle savedInstanceState) {
033    binding = FragmentPinsBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
034    binding.newPin.setOnClickListener((v) -> Navigation.findNavController(binding.getRoot())
035        .navigate(MapsPinsNavGraphDirections.editPin()));
036    // TODO: 3/27/25 Fix this binding issue. New pin is now in the bottom fragment.
037    return binding.getRoot();
038  }
039
040  @Override
041  public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
042    super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
043    LifecycleOwner lifecycleOwner = getViewLifecycleOwner();
044    pinViewModel = new ViewModelProvider(requireActivity()).get(PinViewModel.class);
045    pinViewModel
046        .getPins()
047        .observe(lifecycleOwner, this::handlePins);
048  }
049
050  private void handlePins(List<Pin> pins) {
051    PinsAdapter adapter;
052    adapter = new PinsAdapter(requireContext(), pins, (v, pin, position) -> {
053
054      PopupMenu popup = new PopupMenu(requireContext(), v);
055      Menu menu = popup.getMenu();
056      popup.getMenuInflater().inflate(R.menu.pin_options, menu);
057      menu.findItem(R.id.edit_pin).setOnMenuItemClickListener(item -> {
058        Log.d(TAG, String.format("onMenuItemClick: item=%s", item));
059        Navigation.findNavController(binding.getRoot())
060            .navigate(MapsPinsNavGraphDirections.editPin().setPinId(pin.getId()));
061        return true;
062      });
063      menu
064          .findItem(R.id.delete_pin)
065          .setOnMenuItemClickListener((item) -> {
066            Log.d(TAG, String.format("onMenuItemClick: item=%s", item));
067            pinViewModel.delete(pin);
068//            adapter.notifyItemRemoved(position);
069            return true;
070          });
071      popup.show();
072      return true;
073    });
074    binding.pins.setAdapter(adapter);
075  }
076
077
078}
